title: Verify your Discord tag?
intro: Logging in didn't verify it. Verifying lets the organizers reach you during a tournament. It's optional, but some tournaments require it to register, and so does casting a match.

referees.label: Referees
referees.with: If you're entered in an ongoing or upcoming tournament; for a match you cast, from when its opponents are known until it ends

match.label: Your match (teams, caster)
match.with: From when your opponents are known until it ends (caster, and the teams of a match you cast: during the match)

players.label: Other players
players.with: If you tick “Discord tag” in your settings

dms.label: Match DMs from the bot
dms.with: Yes, unless you turn them off

link.label: Linking of your Discord account
link.with: The code received by direct message links it, unless that Discord is already linked to another account: you can then log in through Discord

undo: Removing your tag or changing your Discord username removes the verification.
later: You can always verify from “My profile”.
neverSaved: You won't see this suggestion again. You can always verify from “My profile”.
certifyChanged: Your Discord account changed since you logged in: verify your tag from “My profile”.
certifyFailed: Verification failed. Try again, or go through “My profile”.
neverFailed: Your choice couldn't be saved. Try again.
sessionEnded: Your session has ended: log in again.
otherAccount: Another account is logged in on this browser: nothing was saved.
titleNoTag: Add and verify your Discord tag?
introNoTag: Your account has no Discord tag yet. Adding and verifying it lets the organizers reach you during a tournament. It's optional, but some tournaments require it to register, and so does casting a match.
